name: severity-ramp-v1
description: Twelve severity ramps authored in this repository for the Score ordinality probe. Each ramp fixes a subject and walks the true level from 0 to 4, changing only the clause that carries the severity. Every item shares one five-level rubric and one instruction, and the levels are always presented in order. Labels are the author's reading, chosen so the walk is as unarguable as a written scenario allows; they are not drawn from an external dataset.

rubric.instructions: How severe is the reported issue?
criteria: Cosmetic: the product works and nothing is lost
Minor: the task still completes, but it is slower or clumsier
Impaired: the task fails, and a documented workaround exists
Severe: the task fails, and there is no workaround
Blocking: the product cannot be used at all

states: The export button's label sits two pixels off center. Every export runs and the file is correct.
The export button takes two clicks instead of one. Every export runs and the file is correct.
The export button does nothing. Exports still run from the File menu, which the help page documents.
The export button does nothing, and no other path to an export exists. The rest of the product works.
The export button crashes the product, and the product crashes again on every start afterwards. Nothing in it can be used.
The search box's placeholder text is a shade lighter than the design calls for. Every search returns the right records.
The search box takes about four seconds to answer. Every search returns the right records.
The search box returns nothing for any query. The documented filter panel still finds the same records.
The search box returns nothing for any query, and no other way to find a record exists. The rest of the product works.
The search box locks the window as soon as the page loads, and that page loads on sign-in. Nothing in the product can be used.
The password reset email signs off with last year's copyright line. The link works and the reset completes.
The password reset email arrives about ten minutes late. The link works and the reset completes.
The password reset email never arrives. An administrator can still reset the password from the admin console, which the help page documents.
The password reset email never arrives, and no other way to reset a password exists. Signed-in users can still work.
The password reset email never arrives, and every session was signed out overnight. Nobody can sign in, so nothing in the product can be used.
The invoice PDF puts the logo three pixels low. Every figure on it is right.
The invoice PDF takes about thirty seconds to build. Every figure on it is right.
The invoice PDF shows the wrong tax total. The documented CSV export carries the right figure.
The invoice PDF shows the wrong tax total, and no other billing document exists. The rest of the product works.
The invoice PDF job holds the whole database connection pool open, and every page now times out. Nothing in the product can be used.
Mobile sync reports its last run in the wrong time zone in the status line. Every record syncs.
Mobile sync runs every thirty minutes instead of every five. Every record syncs.
Mobile sync never runs on its own. The documented pull-to-refresh still syncs every record.
Mobile sync never runs, and pull-to-refresh was removed, so a phone cannot take new records. The web app works.
Mobile sync corrupts the local store on start, and the app closes the moment it opens. Nothing in the app can be used.
In dark mode one divider line keeps the light theme's gray. Everything is readable.
In dark mode the settings page flashes white for a moment on open. Everything is readable after that.
In dark mode the form labels are white on white and cannot be read. The documented light theme restores them.
In dark mode the form labels cannot be read, and the theme switch was removed, so the forms cannot be filled in. The rest of the product works.
Dark mode draws every page as a blank black screen and cannot be turned off. Nothing in the product can be used.
The save shortcut is written as Ctrl+S in a menu that should say Cmd+S. The shortcut saves.
The save shortcut works only after the editor has been clicked once. It then saves.
The save shortcut does nothing. The documented Save button still saves.
The save shortcut does nothing, and the Save button was removed, so work cannot be saved. Everything else works.
The save shortcut fires on every keypress and freezes the editor, and the editor opens on start-up. Nothing in the product can be used.
The upload dialog's progress bar is two pixels too tall. Every file uploads.
The upload dialog shows no progress until the file is finished. Every file uploads.
The upload dialog rejects every file. The documented drag-and-drop area still accepts them.
The upload dialog rejects every file, and drag-and-drop was removed, so nothing can be uploaded. The rest of the product works.
Each upload attempt fills the server's disk, and every request now returns an error. Nothing in the product can be used.
The notification bell's badge sits one pixel off the icon's corner. Every notification is listed.
The notification bell updates its badge a minute after a notification arrives. Every notification is listed.
The notification bell never shows a badge. The documented notifications page still lists every notification.
The notification bell never shows a badge, and the notifications page was removed, so a notification cannot be seen. The rest of the product works.
The notification poll runs in a tight loop and pins the browser tab, and it starts on sign-in. Nothing in the product can be used.
The report chart's axis labels use last quarter's font. Every point is plotted correctly.
The report chart redraws about five seconds after the page settles. Every point is plotted correctly.
The report chart plots last month's figures instead of this month's. The documented table view shows this month's.
The report chart plots last month's figures, and the table view was removed, so this month's cannot be read anywhere. The rest of the product works.
The report chart's query locks the reporting tables, and every page that reads them now hangs. Nothing in the product can be used.
The calendar invite writes the organizer's name in lower case. The time and the link are right.
The calendar invite arrives about five minutes after the meeting is created. The time and the link are right.
The calendar invite carries the wrong time zone. The documented meeting page shows the right time.
The calendar invite carries the wrong time zone, and the meeting page was removed, so the right time is nowhere. The rest of the product works.
The calendar service rejects every request from the product, and the retry loop blocks the request queue. Nothing in the product can be used.
The API key page draws the key in a slightly narrower font than the rest of the page. The key works.
The API key page takes about eight seconds to reveal a key. The key works.
The API key page cannot create a key. The documented command-line tool still creates one.
The API key page cannot create a key, and the command-line tool was withdrawn, so no key can be created. Existing keys still work.
The API key page revoked every key on deploy and cannot issue a new one. Nothing in the product can be used.
